reply: Thank you for explaining that you have been unable to enroll in online banking for your new accounts, and that you were told a branch visit is needed because of a restriction on your business account. We understand how frustrating this has been. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team, including whether the paperwork can be confirmed without a branch visit. Please keep copies of the documents you signed online and a record of your calls. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your account was frozen without warning and that $9,700.00 has been out of reach for over a year. We are sorry for the hardship this has caused, from late rent to delayed retirement plans. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep your last statements showing the balance at the time of the freeze and any notices you received. Money held in an insured account is protected even during disruptions. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $1,100.00 flight charge was turned into a travel credit instead of the cash return you were told you would receive when the airline rebooked your ticket. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. To support the review, please send a written dispute that names the original charge and the date of the call, and keep the old and new confirmation details. The card issuer must acknowledge a written billing dispute within a set time. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that $1,600.00 in digital transactions you did not make were taken from your account, and that your dispute was denied without the documentation you asked for. We are sorry this happened during a medical crisis. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please send a written request for the documents the decision relied on, and keep a record of the date you first reported the transactions. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that your account was closed without a clear reason and that you can no longer open a new one, and that you believe a former spouse changed your details. We understand how worrying this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. You can ask which consumer report was used in the decision and request a free copy to check for information you do not recognize. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a used engine you paid $1,700.00 for does not run, and that your claim was denied while the seller will not respond. We understand how much you rely on your car for work. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep your receipt, any messages with the seller and the mechanic's findings. Some states have laws that cover defective vehicle parts and sales, so check what applies where you live. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that you were asked to pay about $290.00 from an old closed account, without details of what it is for. We understand why you want proof before paying. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please ask in writing for the account records behind this balance, including the date it was charged off and what the charges were. Keep a copy of your request. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your paycheck deposit was returned to your employer without notice, and the serious effect this has had on your health and daily needs. We are very sorry for the distress this has caused. Your complaint has been logged for review by the deposit operations team, including your request for a written explanation. Please keep your pay records and any notices about the returned deposit. Your employer's payroll team can confirm when the deposit was returned. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us about the $340.00 in unauthorized charges taken from your checking account and your concern that the dispute was not fully investigated. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team, including your request for a written explanation. Please keep a record of the date you reported the charges and any reference numbers you were given. Prompt reporting of unauthorized electronic transfers helps protect your rights. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that an account you never opened is being reported on your checking account consumer reports as a charge-off, and that your identity theft dispute has not removed it. We understand how this is blocking you from opening an account. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please also file a dispute with the company that supplied the information, and keep copies of your Identity Theft Report and documents. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your checking account was closed without a clear reason and that you have been labeled a risk you cannot understand. We know how upsetting this is after years of responsible banking. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. You can request a free copy of your checking account consumer report to see what was reported, and dispute any information you believe is wrong. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your debit card fraud claim for $320.00 was denied because the card chip was used, even though you filed a police report. We understand why you disagree with that reasoning. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please ask in writing for the documents the decision relied on, and keep your police report and sworn statement together. Reporting unauthorized electronic transfers quickly helps protect your rights. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that your fraud dispute has left you without access to your money while you are travelling, and that the information you were given has been inconsistent. We are sorry for how your calls were handled. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team, including the service you received. Please keep a note of the dates and times of your calls, and only contact the bank through a number you trust. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your concerns that your disputes were not investigated properly and that you were told the lost funds could not be traced. We understand how concerning this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please list each transaction you reported, with its date and amount, and keep any dispute notices you received. This will help the review look at each claim. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were overcharged on a kiosk purchase and that your request to dispute the charge on your checking account was not taken. We are sorry the calls ended without help. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please put your dispute in writing with the date, merchant and amount, and keep your receipt and any reply from the merchant. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a debit card for an account you never opened was sent to an old address, and that no one has followed up since the branch visit. We understand how concerning this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team, including how the account was opened. Please ask for written confirmation that the account is closed, and review your credit reports for other accounts you do not recognize. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you met the steps for the welcome bonus, including the recurring transfers, and that the bonus has not been paid after many calls and emails. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team, including the referral bonus. Please keep the enrollment email, your statements showing each automatic transfer and your case number. Having the transfer dates listed will help the review match them to the offer terms. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that rent funds were taken from your account but never reached your landlord, and that a temporary credit was later reversed. We are sorry you had to pay the rent and a late fee a second time. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the screenshots of the withdrawals, the rent portal record and the late fee notice, and ask in writing for the reasons for the dispute decision. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your new account was closed after you moved your opening deposit, and that a $1,300.00 paycheck deposit is being held. We understand how concerning it is to be without your pay. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team, including the welcome bonus and the held deposit. Please keep the trace number for the deposit and your account opening documents, and ask in writing how the funds will be returned. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that $1,300.00 has been held in your account for over a month and that you need the funds to buy medication. We are sorry you have not been given a clear answer. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team, including your request for the reason for the hold. Please keep copies of your letters and a record of each contact. Please do not share full account numbers by email. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you left a hotel early because of unsafe conditions, that your debit card was charged twice, and that a refund was later reversed. We are sorry your children were affected. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please put the dispute in writing with the stay dates and amounts, and keep any receipts, medical records and statements from witnesses. If the merchant's response does not resolve it, the review will consider the dispute. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $1,800.00 mobile deposit appeared as available, that your balance then dropped without a hold notice, and that your escalation calls were disconnected. Your complaint has been logged for review by the deposit operations team, including when the hold notice was issued. Please keep screenshots of your account activity and the notice as it appeared online, and ask the bank about its timetable for mobile check deposits. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your IRA rollover has been delayed for nearly a month and that you cannot reach the company handling it. We understand your concern about the money being out of the market. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep the tracking details for the envelope you mailed, copies of the checks and a record of each call, and ask for written confirmation of where the funds are now. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have had trouble getting your past statements and access to your deposits, and that a $100.00 dispute was denied. We understand how frustrating this has been. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please ask in writing for copies of your statements since the account was opened, and for the reasons behind the dispute decision. Only use contact details you trust when sharing your information. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your bank accounts were deleted by mistake while you were trying to add your wife to your account, and that you still cannot reach your funds. We understand how urgent this is with payments due in three days. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team, together with the ticket that was raised. Please keep a record of the call and the ticket details, and let your billers know about the delay. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your concerns about promotional text messages sent through the referral program. We understand that unwanted marketing messages are frustrating. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. If you are receiving these messages, please keep copies of them with the dates and the numbers they came from, and you can reply to the sender to ask not to be contacted again. Keeping good records of these communications will support the review. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your account was restored and then restricted again for unusual activity, and that you were not given a reason. We are sorry that you cannot pay your phone bill and may face extra fees. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep the notices you received and a record of each call, and ask in writing what is needed to lift the restriction. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your account was closed after a check deposit and that the branch would not release your funds as the phone agent said. We understand how upsetting the conflicting information was. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team, including your concern about how you were treated. Please keep a note of the dates and names of the people you spoke with, and ask in writing how the funds will be returned. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that thirteen withdrawals totaling about $8,000.00 were made from your account by someone else, and that you have not been reimbursed. We understand how serious this loss is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please list every transaction with its date and amount, and keep a record of when you reported them. Reporting unauthorized electronic transfers promptly helps protect your rights. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that only part of the unauthorized transactions from the same merchant were credited, and that your request for a written explanation was refused. We understand why you want the remaining transactions looked at. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please list the remaining transactions with dates and amounts, and keep proof of any items you returned or refused. Federal law gives added protections for electronic transfers you did not agree to. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
